notes: Checked against the Open Chemistry collection page and five course pages. The collection page says CC BY-SA 3.0, but course pages state different licences: Chem 1A CC BY-SA 3.0 Unported, Chem 51A and Chem 203 CC BY-SA 3.0 US, Chem 131A CC BY-SA 4.0, and Chem 1P states none. All the ones stated allow commercial use, but the licence has to be read course by course, and lecture by lecture where a video says otherwise. The site's Terms of Use section read "In construction..." on 2026-11-11, so no terms were found. The videos are on YouTube, which wasn't read; each video's own licence there wasn't checked. Recommended textbooks listed on course pages aren't openly licensed. Link only until a course's and a video's licence are read. The bank's agents don't read it and nothing from it goes into the bank.
